components.name: Inline Link
components.description: Link inside prose with an optional leading Central icon and a hairline underline.
components.html: See my code on GitHub.
components.css: .ds-prose { font: 400 16px/1.625 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--foreground, #f5f5f5) 70%, transparent); } .ds-inline-link { color: var(--foreground, #f5f5f5); text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; border-radius: 6px; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-inline-icon { display: inline-block; width: 1em; height: 1em; vertical-align: -0.125em; margin-right: 4px; } .ds-underline { text-decoration: underline 1px; text-decoration-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--foreground, #f5f5f5) 25%, transparent); text-underline-offset: 3px; transition: text-decoration-color 150ms; } .ds-inline-link:hover .ds-underline { text-decoration-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--foreground, #f5f5f5) 60%, transparent); } .ds-inline-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #737373); }

components.name: Project Row
components.description: Whole-row link to a project: icon tile, underlined name, muted description, hover arrow.
components.html: echoThe note taker that learns with you
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; border-radius: 14px; outline-offset: 4px; text-decoration: none; font: 400 16px/1.375 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #737373); } .ds-tile { display: grid; place-items: center; flex-shrink: 0; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--muted, #1f1f1f); color: var(--muted-foreground, #818181); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--border, #242424); transition: color 150ms; } .ds-tile svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; } .ds-row:hover .ds-tile { color: var(--foreground, #f5f5f5); } .ds-row-text { min-width: 0; } .ds-row-name { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; color: var(--foreground, #f5f5f5); } .ds-row-underline { text-decoration: underline 1px; text-decoration-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--foreground, #f5f5f5) 25%, transparent); text-underline-offset: 3px; transition: text-decoration-color 150ms; } .ds-row:hover .ds-row-underline { text-decoration-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--foreground, #f5f5f5) 60%, transparent); } .ds-row-arrow { width: 14px; height: 14px; color: var(--muted-foreground, #818181); opacity: 0; translate: -2px 2px; transition: opacity 150ms, translate 150ms; } .ds-row:hover .ds-row-arrow { opacity: 1; translate: 0 0; } .ds-row-desc { display: block; color: var(--muted-foreground, #818181); }

narrative.overview:
One narrow column of text on a near-black neutral ground. The copy and the work carry the page; the interface recedes until a link or a row is touched. Hierarchy comes from weight and tone, never from size: everything is Inter at 16px, separated into three ink tiers and set apart by generous vertical space.

The world is brief-pinned. Its form follows the user's four reference sites (Jakub Krehel, Lee Robinson, Emil Kowalski, interfaces.dev); no concept roll ran, seed key "none (pinned)". It is dark only and carries no accent color. Detail lives in small, deliberate touches: hairline underlines, 1.5px stroke icons in currentColor, faint inset rings, one staggered blur-up entrance.
keyCharacteristics: One type size (16px); hierarchy by weight (500 vs 400) and ink tier.
Neutral greys only; no accent hue anywhere.
Hairline underlines and inset 1px rings instead of borders and shadows.
Motion is one staged entrance plus 150ms hover state changes.

rules.name: The No Accent Rule
rules.body: The palette has no hue. Emphasis is earned by moving up an ink tier (muted, soft, full), never by color.

rules.name: The Three Tiers Rule
rules.body: Text uses exactly three tones: full ink for things you can act on or name, soft ink for prose, muted ink for supporting lines. A fourth tone is drift.

rules.name: The One Size Rule
rules.body: All text is 16px. New sections get hierarchy from weight 500, ink tier, and space, not from a larger size.

rules.name: The Inset Edge Rule
rules.body: Containers are defined by a 1px inset ring, never by an outer shadow or a solid border.

dos: Do keep every new section inside the 576px column, separated by 80px, with a weight-500 16px heading 16px above its content.
Do use the three ink tiers: full for names and links, 70% for prose, muted for supporting lines.
Do draw icons from Central Icons (round-outlined, radius 2, 1.5px stroke) in currentColor.
Do signal interactivity with the 25% to 60% underline shift and 150ms transitions.
Do gate entrance motion behind reduced-motion and keep it to one staged reveal.
donts: Don't introduce an accent color; the palette is neutral by commitment.
Don't raise font size for hierarchy; the system is one size.
Don't use drop shadows or solid borders on containers; use the 1px inset ring.
Don't ship a light theme; the system is dark only.
